profile.address: Avenida de la Industria, 15, 28108 Alcobendas, Madrid, Spain
profile.reading: This is DC03, the third data center building under development on DATA4s MAD01 campus in Alcobendas, on the northern outskirts of Madrid, Spain, at Avenida de la Industria 15. DATA4 is a French headquartered data center developer and operator active across Europe. DC03 is planned at roughly 15,000 square meters, about 161,000 square feet, across three floors, joining the campus existing DC01 building, which launched in 2020, and DC02, completed in 2022 at about 3,000 square meters of white space. Combined, the MAD01 campus occupies about 4 hectares and DATA4s own materials describe the campus total power capacity at 50 megawatts once fully built, with 24/7 CCTV monitoring, connectivity to about 220 cloud providers and carriers, and ISO 9001, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS certifications. DATA4 markets the Madrid campuses as a strategic convergence point for connectivity between Europe, Africa, the Americas, and the Middle East, located about 10 minutes from central Madrid, and distinguishes the MAD01 campus focus on colocation services from the hyperscaler oriented MAD02 campus it is separately building at San Agustin del Guadalix. DATA4 was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Paris, led by chief executive Olivier Micheli since November 2014. The company describes itself as a European data center operator and investor that finances, designs, builds, and operates its own facilities rather than developing for third parties, and as of recent reporting runs 22 operational data centers with potential for 41 across France, Italy, Spain, Luxembourg, and a newly announced expansion into Poland, managing roughly 129 hectares of campus land and about 209 megawatts of power capacity company wide. DATA4s ownership passed from AXA Investment Managers Alternatives to Brookfield Infrastructure Partners in a 2.4 billion dollar deal agreed in April 2023 and completed that August, moving the operator into Brookfields global infrastructure portfolio.
